text:
Erin Walsh: Spontaneous idea 11 rooftop fondue + acoustic open-mic next Friday at sunset? thinking cheese + chocolate fountain, soft guitars, low-key. :cheese_wedge::guitar:
Ben Ortiz: 100% on board. what time does sunset happen?
Kira Matsumoto: sunset~7:45pm that day. can we do 7-9pm window?
Erin Walsh: 7pm setup, music starts at 7:30. bring an instrument or a song if you want to perform (no pressure).
Mateo Cruz: can i bring a portable gas warmer for the fondue? landlord ok with it?
Erin Walsh: rooftop manager said small propane burners are fine as long as they're away from planters. i'll coordinate safety.
Dana Singh: i'm vegan. any plant-based cheese options?
Ben Ortiz: i can bring a cashew-based fondue i make. works great for vegans.
Kira Matsumoto: i'll bring disposable plates + utensils and napkins. also a bluetooth mic + stand if someone needs it.
Erin Walsh: quick poll: react :guitar: if you might perform, :cheese: if you want fondue, :cake: if you just want snacks & watching.
Ben Ortiz: :cheese:
Kira Matsumoto: :guitar:
Mateo Cruz: :cheese:
Dana Singh: :cake: (but excited for the vibes)
Erin Walsh: RSVP so far: Erin, Ben, Kira, Mateo, Dana. plus feel free to bring one guest but note it on RSVP.
Ben Ortiz: i can help haul tables and a couple folding chairs from the office storage.
Kira Matsumoto: notes on noise: rooftop has a 10pm quiet rule. we'll wrap by 9:30 latest.
Erin Walsh: can someone add to calendar please? i get scatterbrain on event days.
calendar-bot: Event created "Rooftop Fondue & Acoustic Night" Friday 7:00 PM. RSVP: https://cal.example.com/event/8841
Erin Walsh: link posted 1 please RSVP there and mark +1s. i'll make a short checklist for supplies tomorrow. :sparkles:
